comment: Oversized-frame rejection vectors per shared/relay-frame-decoder.ts:126-134 (publish error), 167-179 (discardOversizedPayload), 66-74 (retained limit). No oversized payload is ever allocated: declared length MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE+1 with fewer real bytes.

cases.name: oversized header then next valid frame survives
cases.expected_error_contains: Frame payload too large: 16777217 bytes — discarded
cases.comment: Case 1 per relay-frame-decoder.ts:127-133 + 167-179: the oversized header is discarded, then the declared payload byte count is dropped from the buffer across turns — any trailing bytes are consumed as the oversized payload. A trailing frame survives only if more than oversized_length bytes follow, so with a small trailer none survives (0 final frames).

cases.name: oversized payload bytes consumed across turns
cases.expected_error_contains: Frame payload too large: 16777217 bytes — discarded

cases.name: boundary: exactly MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE payload is NOT oversized
cases.comment: decoder.ts:126 uses strict >; a full 16MiB-1 frame in the fixture would be too large to embed, the test asserts the boundary on the header path only
